parsed.summary: This paper introduces Agent-Reflex, a general training framework designed to teach language agents to act reflectively under noisy tool feedback and user corrections. The framework consists of three stages: Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) to mine reflection meta-skills, Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) to internalize these skills, and On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to provide token-level reflection supervision. Evaluated on six benchmarks, Agent-Reflex-8B significantly improves long-horizon tool use and robustness to interaction noise while maintaining stable training dynamics.

chk_problem.value: Existing language agents lack proactive reflection and failure recovery capabilities when deployed in real-world environments with noisy tool feedback and user corrections.
chk_problem.paper_quote: In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery.

chk_method.value: Agent-Reflex, a three-stage training framework consisting of Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD), Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT), and On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO).
chk_method.paper_quote: To address this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflective thinking in agents.

chk_data.value: A dataset of 1,170 reflection meta-skills mined across 557 environments, along with a fine-tuning corpus of 54K trajectories.
chk_data.paper_quote: From a diverse LLM agent pool, we sample trajectories covering varied task types and response styles, and matched success/failure pairs are then mined into 1,170 reflection meta-skills across 557 environments.

chk_setup.value: Evaluation on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks (BFCL-v4, ACEBench, ToolSandbox, τ2-Bench, VitaBench) and AgentNoiseBench, using Qwen3-8B as the backbone.
chk_setup.paper_quote: We evaluate our method on two groups of benchmarks. (1) Long-horizon tool use covers general function calling and interactive workflows: BFCL-v4 (Patil et al., 2025), ACEBench (Chen et al., 2025), 200 stratified ToolSandbox tasks (Lu et al., 2025), τ 2 -Bench (Barres et al., 2025), and VitaBench (He et al., 2025).

chk_primary_result.value: Agent-Reflex-8B achieves an overall score of 58.6 on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench.
chk_primary_result.paper_quote: Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines.

chk_secondary_result.value: Agent-Reflex improves robustness to noise and maintains stable training dynamics during reinforcement learning.
chk_secondary_result.paper_quote: Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents’ robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training.

chk_baseline.value: Comparison against three families of baselines: reflection methods, environment-scaling methods, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning algorithms.
chk_baseline.paper_quote: We compare three families: reflection methods (Shinn et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2024; Yuan et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2026), environment-scaling methods (Li et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2025; Song et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026b; Xu et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2026a), and trajectory-level RL algorithms (Shao et al., 2024; Yu et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2026).

chk_conclusion.value: Agent-Reflex successfully teaches language agents to act reflectively, improving performance in long-horizon tool use and noisy environments with stable training dynamics.
chk_conclusion.paper_quote: Across six challenging agent benchmark suites, Agent-Reflex improves long-horizon tool use and robustness under tool and user noise with stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training.

chk_limitation.value: The reflection skill library is mined offline from a fixed snapshot of environments and does not automatically adapt to changes in tool interfaces or environment dynamics.
chk_limitation.paper_quote: Consequently, it does not automatically adapt to changes in tool interfaces, service behavior, or environment dynamics.
